spec_match.rationale: Constructs AudioContext({renderSizeHint: N}) for real, but `ctx.renderQuantumSize||128` presents a hardcoded 128 as if read from the API when the property is not exposed, and 'underrun risk' is an editorial heuristic not a measurement.

interactive.rationale: Start/stop of the 220Hz oscillator with per-quantum stats works — CDP-verified: stats populated (128 frames, 44100 Hz, 2.90 ms quantum, baseLatency 10.00 ms).

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises spinning a tone at each quantum size and surfacing CPU budget, latency, and underrun risk; the page does that (within the hint-support limits of the browser).

edge_cases.rationale: try/catch falls back to a plain AudioContext on constructor rejection, but there is no messaging when the hint is ignored and no distinction between exposed and assumed quantum size.

references.rationale: No chromestatus.com/feature/<id> link on the page — see-also lists only the two sibling concepts, breaking the invariant-3 self-heal contract.

conformance.rationale: Covered by the honest, guarded feature suite (7/7 here).

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP-driven start with clean console; the hint's actual effect on quantum size is unobservable in Chromium 141 so only the default path was verified.

telemetry_health.rationale: Server-injected /public/demo-telemetry.js verified in the served DOM.

design_system.rationale: Compact page using shared variables for controls, stats, and code block.

accessibility.rationale: Select is labelled and buttons native, but the stats readout re-renders with no live region.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-measured 373px content width at a 360px viewport — a ~13px protrusion of a controls-row span is clipped; otherwise the layout holds.

openQuestions.title: Add the chromestatus feature link
openQuestions.detail: Invariant 3: link chromestatus.com/feature/5078190552907776 in see-also so the self-heal script can recover this folder.

openQuestions.title: Distinguish read vs assumed renderQuantumSize
openQuestions.detail: `const rq=ctx.renderQuantumSize||128` displays '128 frames' as a live readout even when the property is undefined (pre-153/OT browsers) and the user asked for 32 — label the value 'not exposed, rendering at the 128 default' in that case so the sweep does not appear to have honoured the hint.

openQuestions.title: Fix 13px mobile protrusion
openQuestions.detail: At 360px a controls-row span reaches 373px and is clipped by body overflow-x:hidden; allow the row to wrap.

summary: Compact and genuinely runnable (CDP-verified oscillator start with live stats), but it silently substitutes 128 for an unexposed renderQuantumSize, is missing the mandatory chromestatus link, and has a minor 13px mobile clip. Browser-verified with headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via CLI (screenshot + DOM dump) and raw CDP (real click dispatch, console/network capture, 360x740 DPR3 mobile emulation) — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud session. Chromium 141 predates Chrome 145, so v145-only API paths were validated on their fallback branches, not the new-API success path. The single failed fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet request is environmental (blocked host) and was not counted against any page.
